summary: The prior PASS is confirmed on the new HEAD. CLI, output, and bubble contracts remain valid; F3 and one transaction edge remain nonblocking tech debt.
nonblocking_findings: F3 [Blocker] review-c: A present but empty or header-only MANIFEST.tsv is accepted as an empty manifest. readManifestRows() discards the first line and does not validate the header or require data rows (scripts/prepare.mjs:307-323); manifestToForgeInput() then returns an empty cast map (lines 353-388), and prepare() treats the lack of covered actors as a placeholder/local-art fallback instead of an error (lines 658-679). render.mjs calls prepare() before rendering (scripts/render.mjs:44), so corrupted handoff data can silently produce placeholder output. Reject an invalid header or empty manifest with a clear error; keep fallback only when the handoff or MANIFEST.tsv is absent. Rationale: empty/header-only input is malformed against the T2.1 manifest contract, and the consumer otherwise receives the wrong art without a failed render. | accepted risk, tech debt at track close (PM 2026-11-23: new edges after the last fix round go to tech debt)

F4 [Nit] review-c: The render path copies song.mp3 before it calls prepareWithManifest (scripts/prepare.mjs:643-669; scripts/render.mjs:44). If manifest validation or Forge staging then fails, the output can hold new audio with the prior spec and Forge set, despite prepareWithManifest staging the three files together (scripts/prepare.mjs:452-543). The new ADV-P1-F9 test exercises prepareWithManifest directly, not prepare() or the render entry. | tech debt (PM 2026-11-23)
